questions.q_en: If 3 March 2020 was Tuesday, then what was the day of the week on 3 February 2019?
questions.solution_en:
Time period from 4th February 2019 to 3rd March 2020 =

25 days of February +

31 days of March +

30 days of April +

31 days of May +

30 days of June +

31 days of July +

31 days of August +

30 days of September +

31 days of October +

30 days of November +

31 days of December +

31 days of January +

29 days of February +

3 days of March

= 394 days

So, from 394/7, the remainder will be 2.

Thus, Tuesday - 2 days = Sunday

questions.q_en:
A statement is followed by two arguments I and II. Read the statement and the arguments carefully and select the appropriate answer from the given options.

Statement: Hydroelectricity is a cleaner and greener energy than other forms of power generation.

Arguments:

(I) Hydroelectric plants almost have nil CO2 emissions.

(II) Hydroelectric power projects submerge huge amounts under water thereby affecting local flora and fauna.
options_en: Both I and II weaken the statement
I weakens while II strengthens the statement
II weakens while I strengthens the statement
Both I and II strengthen the statement
questions.solution_en:
Argument I supports the statement by highlighting that hydroelectricity emits almost no CO₂, making it cleaner and greener than fossil fuel-based power. Argument II, however, points out the negative ecological impact - flooding of large areas and damage to biodiversity - which challenges the "greener" claim. Thus, I strengthens the statement by emphasizing environmental cleanliness, while II weakens it by exposing ecological drawbacks.

Thus, II weakens while I strengthens the statement.

So, option 3 is the correct answer.
